references.text: Kiriathaim is also mentioned here as one of the cities that the tribe of Reuben rebuilt after they had taken possession of the land east of the Jordan.
Sibmah is mentioned here as one of the cities that the tribe of Reuben built and which received new names.
Sibmah is mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy against Moab, where the city's vineyards are described as destroyed.
Kiriathaim is mentioned in Jeremiah's judgment against Moab, where the city is conquered and brought to shame.
Kiriathaim is again mentioned as one of Moab's cities that will be struck by judgment.
Sibmah is mentioned in Jeremiah's lament over Moab, with reference to the city's vinevines.
Kiriathaim is mentioned as one of Moab's border cities that will be handed over to people from the east.
